comment: Written by generators/senses (digestmonte) from NIST's CAVP file SHA256Monte.rsp at its pinned bytes (app/specs/oracle/nist-cavp-sha256/lock.json): do not edit. Each example is a 'monte' request of the digest guest, a piece of the file byte for byte, and its answer: the COUNT of every checkpoint the piece judges, which the guest gives only when the checkpoint it reaches by the SHAVS Monte Carlo procedure (1000 digests, each of the three before it) is the MD the file gives. A piece judges four checkpoints, as many as the guest's memory holds. The first piece starts from the file's Seed; each later piece starts one checkpoint back, whose MD is its seed and is not judged again.
